summary: Implemented the show_speed feature. rich/progress.py: track() gained a trailing show_speed=True parameter passed to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed=False, a static render_speed(speed) method (scales via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, returns Text styled progress.percentage, empty Text for None), and render() shows speed when total is unknown and show_speed is on, using finished_speed or speed; Progress.track now leaves the total as None for non-Sized iterables instead of raising. CHANGELOG.md has the new Unreleased/Added line. tests/test_progress.py: removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run: no tests, mypy, or black, per the instructions. Commits were not made.
